newsitem.title: FRANCE: Clasquin to extend its network in Asia and U.S..
newsitem.headline: Clasquin to extend its network in Asia and U.S..

text.p: French freight forwarder, Clasquin, said it planned to extend its network in the Far East and the U.S. by the end of the year.

"In the next two months we hope to open an ocean and airfreight sales office at Qingdao (Tsingtao) in China and before the end of the year in Kuala Lumpur and Los Angeles," Clasquin's chairman, Yves Revol, told Reuters.
An office in Qingdao would reinforce Clasquin's position in China, as the company already had offices in Beijing and Shangai, as well as Hong Kong, Revol said.
"China's economy is opening up more and more creating new markets for ocean and airfreight."
In the Far East sector, Clasquin's network of offices also encompasses Taipei, Seoul, Osaka, Tokyo, Ho Chi Minh City, Bangkok and Singapore.
"From Singapore, it's a logical step to open an office in a neighbouring, developing country such as Malaysia."
In the North American market, Los Angeles would provide Clasquin with a strategic location on the U.S. west coast serving as a bridgehead to transpacific markets, Revol said.
Clasquin's network of offices worldwide also extends to Barcelona, Dakar, Mauritius, Melbourne, Milan, New York and Sydney.
